__README__: FROZEN reviewed inventory of every mutation callsite the deterministic scanner
(callsites.mjs) discovers. It is the BASELINE a change is diffed against, not a claim that
these callsites are safe -- every one of them is an unconverted Batch 3 blocker unless its
disposition says otherwise.
The guard fails on ADDITIONS (an unreviewed callsite appeared) and on REMOVALS (an entry is no
longer found, so it was converted, renamed or moved). Both directions force a human decision.
SCOPE: this correction window INVENTORIES only. Editing these callsites is Batch 3 and is
explicitly out of scope here.
HOW THIS BASELINE WAS PRODUCED
Not hand-written. Emitted by scanRepository() over the authoritative P1 worktree at
claude/canvas-p1-generation@8bb58dba12d38f3984ba8d07935325bd1c09ea4d, including the current
reviewed dirty P1 candidate. The Phase 2 rescan found the original 39 paths/classes,
then each entry retained its reviewed disposition. Phase 4 Batch 1 deliberately retired
the two unsafe deduct/refund routes; Batch 2 removed profile initialization from browser
and SMS signup. Phase 4 Batch 3A then retired the temporary admin absolute-balance
setter and the deprecated Sora POST that charged before returning 410. The active mutation
baseline is now 27 scanner-visible paths plus four exact-hash mutation tombstones, two
trigger-converted signup paths, twenty reviewed shared-boundary paths and one audit-preserving
account-deactivation path. Two reviewed Canvas generation-boundary paths were added for
the production generation service and reconciler. Thirteen legacy lifecycle-only paths remain; the original sixteen
included three hidden video-credit consumers that were reclassified and converted in Group C.
The previous fourteen-path list was
hand-authored, and it was wrong in BOTH directions -- it missed at least nine active mutation paths that Codex
found independently (all nine are present below), and it carried two READ-ONLY routes
(src/app/api/admin/users/[id]/route.ts and .../[id]/credits/route.ts, both `.select(` only)
as if they were unconverted mutations.

__dispositionLegend__.batch3_convert_to_shared_boundary: Mutates profiles.credits and/or the ledger outside canvas_p1_apply_credit_delta_v1. Batch 3 must route it through the shared atomic delta-plus-ledger boundary with a stable server-derived operation anchor, without changing its pricing or provider behaviour.
__dispositionLegend__.batch3_convert_to_deactivation: Performs a destructive hard delete that the anchored-ledger trigger will now REJECT. Batch 3 must convert it to the reviewed audit-preserving deactivation/anonymization path (canvas_p1_deactivate_account_v1) before release.
__dispositionLegend__.batch3_make_unreachable: Unauthenticated or otherwise unsafe mutation surface the frozen contract requires to be removed or made unreachable before P1 release.
__dispositionLegend__.retired_unreachable: The unsafe mutation implementation is absent. The retained route is an exact-hash compatibility tombstone that unconditionally returns HTTP 410 and has no request parsing, admin client, database or provider capability.
__dispositionLegend__.batch3_convert_profile_init: Creates a profile and/or issues signup credits outside the verified auth-event initializer. Must be converted so the only initialization path is canvas_p1_initialize_account_v1, which now backs the live handle_new_user() trigger.
__dispositionLegend__.converted_profile_init_to_auth_trigger: The signup path creates only auth.users and relies on the reviewed on_auth_user_created -> handle_new_user -> canvas_p1_initialize_account_v1 chain for profile creation and the anchored signup grant.
__dispositionLegend__.converted_to_shared_boundary: The path retains its non-credit lifecycle behavior but every profile credit delta and ledger row is delegated to the reviewed atomic task boundary.
__dispositionLegend__.converted_to_deactivation: The hard-delete branch is absent. The legacy delete action delegates to canvas_p1_deactivate_account_v1 so profile PII is anonymized in place while ledger rows, snapshots, foreign keys and operation anchors remain intact.
__dispositionLegend__.canvas_p1_atomic_generation_boundary: Canvas generation lifecycle/projection updates only. Credit consume/refund, action idempotency, provider-task binding, completion, unknown-state handling and reconciliation ownership are delegated to the reviewed Canvas P1 atomic RPC boundary.
__dispositionLegend__.legacy_generation_lifecycle_only: Touches only legacy generations rows (action_id IS NULL) and no credit surface. Not a credit-boundary blocker. Still reviewed and pinned so a credit mutation cannot be added here unnoticed.

__knownScannerLimitations__: Conservative LEXICAL scan, not AST/type-aware. It matches a `.from('<table>')` reference and a
It CANNOT see: a dynamically built table name (`from(tbl)`), a wrapper/helper that hides the
client, raw fetch against PostgREST, or SQL inside an .rpc() body. It cannot prove a matched
site executes, nor that an unmatched file is safe.
It is a CHANGE DETECTOR over a reviewed baseline. It must never be cited as proof that the
conversion surface is complete; that proof is Batch 3's exhaustive audit plus the runtime
